services_shape: sleep clinic: consults and follow-ups with a named sleep doctor or the next open one; an overnight sleep study at the center (a stay from the evening to the morning, with a technologist); a home sleep test kit picked up at the desk and returned by mail; CPAP mask fittings at the center or at home; a video follow-up counts as at the center
questions_before_times: the kind of visit (new consult, follow-up, overnight study, home test kit, mask fitting, home set-up)
whether it's a video follow-up (counts as at the center)
a health plan or self-pay (only the plan's name here)
for a child's overnight study: the child's age, and a parent who stays overnight
for a home visit: the town and whether the patient can come to the door
safety_stop: chest pain, trouble breathing, or a stroke sign (face drooping, arm weakness, or trouble speaking)
first_steps: A sleep history for a new patient
A parent's OK for a child's overnight study
The home test kit's pick-up and return
license: a state license for each sleep doctor and nurse practitioner; a sleep technologist's certificate where the state requires one; the sleep center's registration where the state's rules require it; a technologist who sets up a test or a mask at home only where the state allows it
staff_skills: in-lab sleep studies, home sleep tests, CPAP mask fitting, pediatric sleep studies, Spanish
messages_never: the sleep history, test names, results, medicines, the child's details, ID numbers and plan details never go in a text: only the secure page; texts say only the center's name, the day, the time and the place
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
